name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2026-07-02, at wavelengths from 1.27 to 4.87 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
